label: r4c2
name: r3c3 with lr 1.5e-3
hypothesis: Same as r3c3, but lr 1.5e-3 instead of 1e-3. The learning rate decays linearly to 0 and the agent looks optimisation-limited, since training and dev success are equal, so larger early steps may learn placements and frame selection faster. Refuted if dev success falls below about 0.65 or training becomes unstable.
